_about: Which model each tool uses for the Fast / Standard / Deep tiers in Routing.md. Edit freely. "inherit" means: use whatever model the tool is already set to. null means: leave the model out of the generated file. Model names change often; the quarterly currency audit re-checks this file. Checked 2026-10-13.

claude._note: Claude Code aliases. Effort is written as `effort:` in the agent frontmatter.

codex._note: OpenAI Codex. Effort is written as model_reasoning_effort. OpenAI recommends gpt-6.1-sol for complex agentic work and gpt-6-luna for focused, repeatable tasks.

cursor._note: Cursor. inherit uses the model picked in Cursor. To pin one, use a model ID, optionally with effort in brackets, e.g. "claude-opus-5[effort=high]".

gemini._note: Gemini CLI model aliases. If your CLI version rejects an alias, replace it with a full model ID from /model.

copilot._note: GitHub Copilot. null leaves the model out, so Copilot uses its current model. To pin one, use a model name from Copilot's model picker.
